newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia April palm oil output up 6 pct-Ivan Wong.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia April palm oil output up 6 pct-Ivan Wong.

text.p: Malaysia's palm oil output in April is estimated to have risen by six percent to 723,000 tonnes over March, crop forecaster Ivan Wong said on Wednesday.
Wong put palm oil stocks at the end of April at 695,000 tonnes, compared with the Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority's (PORLA) 689,633 tonnes at end-March.
Exports in April are estimated at 610,000 tonnes against 565,219 tonnes in March.
In a report, Wong said field crop surveys indicated that production growth in the second quarter of the year was likely to be little changed from the 7.8 percent growth posted in the first quarter.
Stocks of processed palm oil were estimated to have increased by 15,000 tonnes to around 345,000 tonnes to meet larger than normal export shipments scheduled in the first week of May, Wong said.
He said the increase in exports was wholly accounted by India and Pakistan which collectively raised their offtake by about 75,000 tonnes to an estimated 185,000 tonnes.
